0022600142.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-0) come in on a four-game winning streak, sitting first in the Northwest Division and first in the West, with a 3-0 home record and a 1-0 road record. The Dallas Mavericks (2-2) are 8th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, two games back, and have won their last game. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee), with Ajay Mitchell (ankle) day-to-day, while Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), with Kyrie Irving (knee) and Naji Marshall (illness) day-to-day. The Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 100-87 win in Dallas on March 1, 2026, and no games have been played yet between the two teams in 2026-27.
